pm_collateral_supplied.meaning: Vault has supplied collateral under PM for the account

pm_borrow_liability_present.meaning: PM borrow-lend state creates a negative quote liability for the account

precompile_payload_has_borrow_and_supply.meaning: 0x811 payload contains borrow.basis, borrow.value, supply.basis and supply.value for the token

settlement_accepted.meaning: settle() accepted the yield settlement instead of blocking it at the distributable-surplus gate

assumptions: The PM account's true net borrow-lend state is negative (borrow liability exceeds supplied collateral) in the reported scenario.
settle() is the settlement path whose distributable-surplus gate is meant to block unbacked yield.
The report describes a potential scenario rather than an observed transaction.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric values for borrow.value, supply.value, surplus or proposedYield, so the negative-net-state and gate-threshold relations cannot be expressed numerically; only the qualitative gate-blocking obligation is formalized.
Report does not specify whether settle() and distributeYield() are separate transactions or their ordering, so the settlement-to-distribution sequence is not bound.

limitations: Only the false-positive yield settlement impact is formalized; downstream USDC movement, USDM minting and share routing are not covered by this plan.
The gate-blocking relation is represented qualitatively because the report supplies no numeric backing, liability or surplus values.
The scenario is potential, so the plan encodes the conditional gate obligation rather than an inevitable settlement.
